newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MIH HOLDINGS LTD H1 LOSS DEEPENS, NO DIV.
newsitem.headline: MIH HOLDINGS LTD H1 LOSS DEEPENS, NO DIV.

text.p: Half year ended September 30
(million rand unless stated)
Shr loss 53.8 cts vs 8.8 cts loss
Div - vs 164.0 cts
Attrib loss 122.1 vs 19.8 loss
Pre-tax loss 126.6 vs 35.8 loss
Tax 5.2 vs 2.1
Finance cost 63.6 vs 7.0
Turnover 850.0 vs 594.0
Share of associates' losses 50.2 vs 12.3 loss
Exceptional item 15.2 vs 59.9
Full name: MIH Holdings Ltd
NOTE - No dividend was declared and MIH said net operating
losses were incurred as a result of continued development of
subscription television operations in Europe, Africa and the
Middle East.
The exceptional item related to profit from the sale of the
company's 15 percent stake in Information Trust Corp (Pty) Ltd.
Directors anticipate that MIH will in the aggregate be
profitable on conclusion of the previously announced merger of
certain European interests via NetHold with France's Canal Plus
They said operations of NetHold, in which MIH holds a 40
percent stake, were still in a growth phase and NetHold was
expected to incur operating losses for the remainder of the
financial year.
-- Johannesburg newsroom -27-11-482.1003
